race.title: Great Gable Mares' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: OH CLARE shaped well over hurdles last season, including here, and might prove the answer switched to fences for her handicap debut/reappearance. Redeeming Love should have a chase win in her this winter and is second choice ahead of Oh Janey . OH CLARE (IRE) REDEEMING LOVE (IRE) OH JANEY (IRE)
